title: dolicholus latifolius
intro: Dolicholus latifolius, commonly known as the broad-leaved dolicholus, is a perennial herb of the plant family Fabaceae. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Dolicholus latifolius include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to reduce pain and inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
